title: Reconstructing Subnational Labor Indicators in Colombia: An Integrated Machine and Deep Learning Approach
abstract: arXiv:2508.12514v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Official labor statistics in Colombia are monthly only at the national level; departments have annual figures, and cities and informality are published as moving windows. This paper presents ICML, an open-source framework that reconstructs monthly series of the labor market, informal employment and employment by sector for the 33 Colombian territories from January 1993 to August 2026. It combines temporal disaggregation, inversion of moving windows, supervised learning with geographic cross-validation and hierarchical reconciliation under exact accounting identities and publishes each territory for two universes: the whole territory and the part represented by the household survey (GEIH). Informality is obtained from priors of a residual neural network calibrated each month to the national rate. translated_title: 重建哥伦比亚次国家级劳动指标：一种机器学习与深度学习相结合的方法
translated_abstract: 哥伦比亚的官方劳动统计仅在全国层面按月发布；省级（departments）只有年度数据，城市和不正规就业数据则以滑动窗口形式发布。本文提出了ICML，一个开源框架，用于重建1993年1月至2026年8月期间哥伦比亚33个地区劳动力市场、非正规就业以及分行业就业的月度时间序列。该框架结合了时间分解、滑动窗口反演、带地理交叉验证的监督学习，以及在精确会计恒等式约束下的层次协调，并为每个地区发布两个口径的数据：整个地区以及家庭调查（GEIH）所覆盖的部分。非正规就业通过残差神经网络的先验获得，该网络每个月根据全国比率进行校准。发布数值与官方数据相比，偏差中位数根据指标不同介于0.04%至0.43%之间，并通过留一省（leave-one-department-out）评估进行验证。
tldr: 本文提出开源框架ICML，综合运用时间分解、滑动窗口反演、地理交叉验证监督学习与残差神经网络等方法，成功重建了哥伦比亚33个地区近三十余年的月度劳动力市场、非正规就业及分行业就业指标，与官方数据偏差中位数仅0.04%至0.43%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ICML, an open-source framework that integrates machine and deep learning techniques—including temporal disaggregation, moving-window inversion, geographically cross-validated supervised learning, and residual neural networks—to reconstruct monthly labor market, informality, and sectoral employment indicators for Colombia's 33 territories from January 1993 to August 2026, achieving median deviations of only 0.04%–0.43% from official figures.
